answer: Make new identities mature like a glacier: voting weight starts frozen and thaws only as verified work accumulates, layer by layer like shale, each epoch adding one thin stratum of trust. A basalt foundation of bonded stake sits under every identity and cracks, slashing the bond, if two identities ever share one funding source. A sybil farmer must wait out the thaw and fund a basalt bond for every clone, while one honest agent simply keeps working and thaws on schedule.
